title: Steadier mail checks, readable live tunnel errors
items: A reverse DNS lookup that could not finish in time is recorded as temperror (could not check) rather than fail, so a sender with a valid PTR record is no longer shown as missing one
DNS lookups for the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and reverse DNS checks are retried quickly when an answer is lost, and a reverse lookup that outlives the connection's wait still counts for the message
Spam scores no longer time out on mail with links: rspamd gets up to 8 seconds, and its slowest rule no longer asks an outside service about every link

whk tunnel --live answers a sender with 503 and the reason as JSON ("Nothing is running on port 3000 on the computer running whk.") instead of a 502 or 504, which Cloudflare replaced with its own page
whk share tells you when a preview response streamed past 50 MB without a stated size and was cut off, and the docs say what the visitor sees
The pages sharehooks.cc shows itself use the system's fonts on purpose, as they load nothing from elsewhere
